{{Quote|Not a very good idea, entering a Mandalorian's room uninvited.|Mandalorian clan leader warning Meetra Surik as she entered the room|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
This '''Individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and leader of a [[Unidentified Mandalorian clan (Nar Shaddaa)|clan]] of Mandalorians on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Dark Wars]]. When the Jedi Exile, [[Meetra Surik]], came to the planet, she with [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver]], encountered this clan. While he had shown to be a little hostile towards outsiders, he was welcoming to Mandalorians when he had mistaken Mandalore for another mercenary. He was eventually convinced by Meetra to join the other clans on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]].
